name: C025 ROOSTERS Antipode/Inversion Governance for Delta/Gamma Theorem Search
purpose: Absorb the defensive and cognitive lessons of the three canonical ROOSTERS artifacts into the C025 theorem-extraction algorithm by inversion: mechanisms that create suppression, blind spots, brittle centralization or silence are retained only as red-team anti-patterns. JANUS uses them to detect and repair epistemic failure, never as theorem authority and never as an inherited hostile objective.

absorbed_abstractions: bounded observation windows can create blind spots
silent packet/session loss is operationally different from an explicit verdict
health-check failure and overload require explicit failover semantics
centralized routing creates single points of systemic influence
redundancy and bypass preserve continuity when a component fails
treat architecture weaknesses as stress tests rather than trusted operating assumptions
false positives and collateral effects are evidence of over-aggressive filtering
human or learned authority must not become a single point of truth
alternate routes and decentralization improve resilience
adversarially test learned detectors because confidence can be brittle
Observe -> Command -> Response -> Evaluate -> Registry Update feedback loop
self-adaptation on anomalies and distribution shifts
control of the interface is more important than loyalty to one model

antipode_law.name: ADOPT_THE_MECHANISM_AS_A_REDTEAM_PROBE__NEVER_ADOPT_THE_HOSTILE_OBJECTIVE
antipode_law.statement: A mechanism observed in the ROOSTERS/TSPU antipode may be simulated to expose JANUS blind spots, but its suppressive objective, silent-failure semantics and centralized truth model are forbidden imports.
forbidden_use: turning suppression into a correctness criterion
granting one model/controller global theorem authority

bounded_window_guard.theorem_translation: A bounded pivot subset, bounded depth, bounded family or bounded runtime may falsify a universal candidate if it finds an exact counterexample, but failure to find one cannot prove the universal candidate.

collateral_damage_inversion.source_pattern: Aggressive filtering can damage legitimate traffic through false positives.
collateral_damage_inversion.theorem_translation: Aggressive heuristic pruning can destroy proof-required candidates through false negatives/false positives in learned ranking.

continuity_and_failover.principle: Preserve the ability to continue searching when a learned route, worker or heuristic fails.
rules: heuristic failure triggers quarantine, not evidence deletion
worker failure triggers reroute or UNKNOWN, never fabricated verdict
surprise can reopen COLD coverage immediately
exact verifier cannot be bypassed by a faster learned path
formal proof gate cannot be bypassed by repeated finite success

anti_chaos_objective.statement: JANUS converts uncertainty and adversarial disorder into explicit structured states without erasing provenance.
anti_chaos_objective.uncertainty_preservation: If uncertainty is real, preserve OPEN/UNKNOWN explicitly.

integration_into_current_theorem_lane.Gamma: min_{(a,b) in G_v2(F)} min_{x in Roots(F)}(U(exists x M_{a,b}(F))-N^2)
